inputs.original_text: Wake up, look at how the machinery operates. The Punjab and Haryana High Court has issued a ruling stating that anticipatory bail cannot be cancelled merely on the ground of non-recovery of stolen articles or the seriousness of allegations. Justice Sumeet Goel ruled that cancellation required clear proof of misuse of liberty or supervening circumstances, dismissing a plea seeking cancellation of pre-arrest bail in a house. It is all part of their carefully coordinated protection system, shielding their chosen operators while they put on a show of legal process for the public. They think we cannot see the strings being pulled behind the bench.
